title: Shared similarity utility: Jaccard + trigram fallback for costume-note and prompt-coverage checks
purpose: Delivers the shared token-overlap utility both cross_shot_v2.py (Forge, c3feea2d) and audit_prompt() (Vera, c5ffe102) need to handle synonym false-positives. Adds character-trigram similarity as a fallback when word-Jaccard is below threshold, so 'crimson coat' vs 'red coat' scores higher than word-Jaccard alone would give. Motivated by art_01M6HRDNCF7PCNDKZNAN1K6R1X r3 open problem: inconsistent temporal coherence. Documents a known remaining limit: trigrams catch morphological variants but not distant synonyms like 'jacket' vs 'coat'.
attribution: Survey motivation: Elmoghany, Rossi, Yoon, Mukherjee, Bakr, Mathur et al. (29 authors), arXiv:2507.07202v1, CC BY 4.0 — cited via art_01M6HRDNCF7PCNDKZNAN1K6R1X r3
